prompts.worker: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve. Asset: transparent 2D game animation sprite sheet, NOT a scene or video. Reference image is the exact tired dungeon repair worker identity and inked cartoon style. Create EXACTLY 12 separate full-body poses of this SAME small repair worker arranged in a strict uniform 4 columns by 3 rows grid, read left to right then top to bottom. Every cell equal size, ample transparent margins, identical character scale and fixed foot baseline; each character faces screen RIGHT in the same three-quarter side view. Teal pointed hood, round brass goggles ON THE HOOD above forehead, human pale face, tired half-closed eyes, brown leather apron with pockets, brown gloves, heavy brown boots. He drags the SAME small gold-trimmed brown wheeled toolbox behind him to the LEFT with the rear hand, and a small wrench in the other hand. Toolbox belongs to EACH full-body pose. Thick dark ink outlines, soft warm cel shading, chibi proportions exactly like reference. Clear visually distinct walking foot poses, not copies. Row1: (1) weary walk left boot forward right boot back; (2) weight drops onto left foot, right heel lifted; (3) passing pose right foot swings past planted left, toes lifted; (4) right boot forward left boot behind. Row2: (5) weight drops onto right foot, left heel lifted; (6) left foot passing the right; (7) stopped with both feet planted, slumped exhausted face; (8) inhaling, shoulders lifted and eyes closing. Row3: (9) exhaling a tired sigh, small round open mouth, shoulders falling, NO drawn breath cloud; (10) deep sigh with eyes closed and head tilted down; (11) finished sigh, heavy slumped shoulders, both boots firmly planted; (12) tired blink in the same settled standing position. Preserve exactly the same costume, goggles, face and toolbox across all cells. Keep entire toolbox, boots and hood inside every cell. No ground, no background, no scenery, no text, no numbers, no labels, no panel borders, no motion lines, no breath puffs. REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background everywhere outside the sprites, not checkerboard pixels.
prompts.backgrounds: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: clean background plate atlas for four-panel game comic. The first reference is the original four-panel hero/worker comic, the second reference is the boss/worker comic. Create ONE 2x2 atlas of FOUR EMPTY dungeon environments in this exact reading order: top-left = first reference TOP LEFT room with open golden dungeon doorway; top-right = first reference BOTTOM LEFT ruined room and stairs through doorway; bottom-left = first reference BOTTOM RIGHT blue stone dungeon wall, rubble and wooden crate at right; bottom-right = second reference TOP LEFT blue stone wall with floor spikes, rubble and torches. Preserve the perspective, architecture, floor line, colors, ink outlines, warm torch lighting and environmental prop placement of those specific source panels as closely as possible. REMOVE ALL characters, heroes, repair workers, demon king, skeletons, bones belonging to soldiers, handheld scrolls, watches, swords, character toolboxes, sweat, breath clouds, motion lines and speech effects. Reconstruct the wall/floor previously behind them. Leave the environmental crate on the right in bottom-left; leave broken floor machinery and spikes. Remove every visible face or body. Keep upper background space for dialogue. Four equally sized 4:3 panels in a strict 2x2 grid, no gutters, no outer border, no text. Opaque background. This is a set of empty background plates for later separately animated sprites, NOT a finished comic with characters.
prompts.cast: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve. Asset: transparent character sprite atlas for the existing comic. Use the first and second reference comic sheets ONLY for exact character identities and drawing style. Create exactly EIGHT isolated cutout sprites in a strict uniform 4-column by 2-row grid, one sprite per cell, ample transparent separation, no touching cells. Thick black ink and warm cel shading, the same chibi cartoon proportions. Row1 left to right: (1) full-body proud blond hero in silver/gold armor and flowing red cape, large sword pointed down, facing screen RIGHT in three-quarter view, from first reference top-left; (2) SAME hero seen from behind walking away toward upper-left, holding a small loot bag, red cape, from first reference bottom-left; (3) full-body nervous standing skeleton guard in helmet and red tabard with spear, from first reference top-left; (4) collapsed skeleton guard bones and ribcage on the floor with expressive surprised skull, NO wooden crate, from first reference bottom-left. Row2 left to right: (5) full-body angry purple demon king boss with crown, red fur-trimmed cape, long checklist scroll, holding a pocket watch and pointing to his right, from second reference top-left; (6) full-body exhausted teal-hooded repair worker, brass goggles on hood, leather apron, wrench and toolbox, cowering toward the boss to his left, from second reference top-left; (7) a smiling disembodied skeleton skull with short neck bones only, facing left, from first reference bottom-right; (8) a SMALL cartoon exhaled breath puff, white soft lobed cloud with dark thin ink contour, no face, no letters. Keep all characters and every accessory entirely inside their own cells. No scenery, no floor, no contact shadows, no crate, no text, no numbers, no panels, no labels. Real transparent alpha background, NOT checkerboard pixels.
